first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence directly supports shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction. A small guarded test is preferable because completion gains could come at the expense of lead quality or downstream qualified revenue; monitor activation, time-to-value, retention, and qualified pipeline rather than completion alone.

mid.rationale: Run a standard, instrumented onboarding-shortening experiment because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the verified record shows strong gains in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention. Do not broadly roll out yet: signup simplification improved SMB activation and qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention, so monitor qualified revenue, retention, activation, and time-to-value—not completion alone.

final2.rationale: The competitor’s deeper cut and doubled price-sensitive SMB churn make targeted promotional pricing the most direct response. Test it narrowly with eligible SMB accounts and clear duration/discount limits; measure qualified revenue, retention, expansion, and contribution margin—not acquisition alone—to avoid buying low-value volume or triggering broader price erosion.
